title: Willcutts review of Forrestal's death

tellings.quote: They followed up with a a kind of investigation. I which I read the transcript uh most of it anyway. the Will Cuts uh review I think it's called.

plain: Richard Dolan, a UFO historian, talks on Jesse Michels' podcast about the 1949 death of James Forrestal, the US Secretary of Defense, at Bethesda Naval Hospital in Maryland. Dolan says the authorities followed up with an investigation, which he thinks is called the Willcutts review, and that he has read most of its transcript. He brings it up as part of his argument that Forrestal's death may be tied to UFO secrets.
